description: Wave 10 preview: --track-dot-cap accumulated-state dot governor. Unsevered -x0 -y0 -B0 -N 1e-3 -C 1000, n=2000/run, per-event core-window (L5-18) W_e from event dumps. Binary /eos/user/j/jeffkrup/agentic/hepemshow-gov/build_gov_fwd/HepEmShow @ knob/dot-governor 3b6d45f (fc388aa + governor).

gap_governor_alone_P250_E50.note: gate-C runs; medians on truth, variance 7.3x/44.6x canonical - far better than uncapped unsevered (1.2e3/2.2e4x) but not competitive with b80 (0.064/0.306x)

gap_compat_b80_plus_gov_1000_50.verdict: PASS the <2sigma bar (z=-1.89, marginal) but variance ~14x the b80-alone level and mean pulled below truth

combined_abs_b80_plus_gov_1000_50.verdict: WRONG SIGN - the governor does NOT rescue the absorber from the gap-tuned boundary cap; b80 amputates the crossing mass at the generator, upstream of the governor. NO unified config in this family.

bar_verdict: P1000:E50 passes the mean bar (1.082 +- 0.087, within 1 sigma of truth - first absorber-channel configuration in the program consistent with FD truth) and is MARGINAL on variance: 74.8x (s1, passes) / 270.7x (s2, fails vs the fluke-low canonical s2 reference 4.5e5); absolute pooled var 1.5e8 = ~105x pooled canonical 1.4e6.

gates.G1_knockoff_byte_identity: PASS - fwd n=2000 s1 canonical: edeps_1+edeps_gap_1 identical ref(fc388aa build_agent_fwd) vs gov build; rev n=2000 s1: barInputs+barInputsPerLayer+edeps_1+edeps_gap_1 identical; bonus: gov knob-off unsevered gap+abs s1 identical to wave-9 fc388aa runs
gates.G2_primal_identity_knob_on: PASS - governor 250:50 vs off, unsevered, gap+abs seeds s1-2: mean_E/var_E byte-identical in edeps+edeps_gap (8/8), derivative column changed 50/50 layers

G3_fwd_eq_rev.never_fires_control_1e30: fwd bit-identical to off; rev bit-identical except barInputsPerLayer 2/202 values at max rel 1.1e-13 (adjoint accumulation order through the identity external function)

governor_on_250_50.note: NOT equal when clamps fire - expected: the forward tangent clamp and reverse adjoint clamp are different regularizations of the same governor; a tangent-nonlinear op has no linear transpose. Reverse governor is recordable, primal-exact, finite and bounded (the tape-compatibility claim verified in that sense)

gates.G4_nan_scan: PASS - 0 nonfinite in all gate outputs, all 14 preview edeps and all event dumps
